name: std_ptr_vector_clear
description: Behavior contract for the canonical VC5 std::vector<HudCmdBindingEntry *>::clear provider; the native smoke helper is test scaffolding, not an authored retail API.
known_limits: VC byte verification does not currently match: VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob0_facs failed for 0x40bdc0 with 43 unmasked mismatches after trimming 6 NOPs.
functional_evidence: Native smoke verifies the helper returns the old end pointer and leaves begin, capacity, and allocator state unchanged while assigning end=begin.
